name: K-D Tree Hierarchy Construction
definition: A k-d tree is used for spatial partitioning to avoid explicitly clipping polygons. Each node splits a region in one dimension at a time. Polygons are stored in a common array `Tid` in prefix-order traversal order.
summary: K-D Tree Hierarchy Construction builds a spatial partitioning binary tree for efficient rendering by associating polygons with the smallest containing node, avoiding subdivision unlike orthogonal BSP trees.
